name: VANDIRA Data-First AI Contract
purpose: Retrieval-first political intelligence with immutable canonical election data and additive live content.
non_negotiables: Canonical election and booth JSON files are read-only and never overwritten by AI or ingestion.
Every external fact must retain source_url, source_name, published_at or retrieved_at, source_tier, and confidence.
2024 Lok Sabha Assembly-segment data must never be described as a 2024 Assembly election result.
Missing data is reported as a data gap; the system must not invent candidates, alliances, issues, forecasts, or probabilities.
Live/current claims require fresh retrieval and must not fall back to stale historical facts without disclosure.
Voice is outside STEP85 and will be integrated only after data and AI retrieval validation.
